name: faqs-07
description: A sticky intro beside a numbered accordion of licensing questions.

files.content:
"use client" import { Plus } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const faqs = [ { question: "What file formats are included?", answer: "Every asset ships as Figma, SVG and PNG. Icon sets also include a React package and an icon font, and 3D files include Blender and GLB sources.", }, { question: "Can I use the assets in client work?", answer: "Yes. The standard licence covers unlimited personal and commercial projects, including work you deliver to clients. You just can't resell the raw files.", }, { question: "How often do you release new resources?", answer: "We publish a new collection every two weeks and update existing packs whenever a platform or design tool changes. All updates are free for members.", }, { question: "Do I keep access if I cancel?", answer: "Anything you downloaded while subscribed stays yours forever under the same licence. You'll only lose access to new releases and the members library.", }, { question: "Is there a team licence?", answer: "Team licences start at five seats and include shared libraries, centralised billing and priority requests for new components.", }, ] export default function Faqs07() { return (

FAQ

Licensing, files and access.

Can't find what you're looking for? Our team usually replies within a few hours.

{faqs.map((faq, index) => ( {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")} {faq.question} {faq.answer} ))}
) }
